environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ECS task role has DynamoDB read/write access. The OAuth provider (oauth.provider.com) is configured with no redirect_uri restriction on the OAuth application registration (accepts any redirect_uri in token exchange). No WAF rules applied to the ALB. Network egress is unrestricted from the Fargate task.

config.iam_policy: DynamoDB full access to Users table, no permission boundary
config.network: Public ALB, unrestricted egress, no WAF
config.oauth_provider_config: redirect_uri validation disabled at provider level
